title: Phase 4 paired chat-to-capability command
purpose: Carry a provider-neutral structured tool request through paired controller signing, relay validation, outbound agent verification, local policy/approval/audit, and bounded result return without letting remote input grant privilege.
entry_condition: Device/controller pairing is persisted locally; device has an active paired session; max-chat has a paired controller identity; provider emits only a declared structured tool call.
authority: Paired Ed25519 identities plus local PC-agent policy and trusted local approval

transitions.action: provider-neutral chat core validates declared tool name and JSON arguments then obtains a controller session bound to the active agent session
controller creates a fresh request ID and Ed25519-signed CommandEnvelope for the relay-provided agent session
relay authenticates paired controller session and verifies signed envelope for current device and agent session
side_effects: record command nonce only after verification

transitions.action: enqueue bounded verified request for the owning device
side_effects: append request to bounded in-memory device queue

transitions.action: authenticate current paired device session on outbound long poll
agent re-verifies controller signature freshness device/session binding and replay
side_effects: record local replay nonce after valid verification

transitions.action: evaluate local capability policy and write required audit decision before privileged side effects
deny shell unknown or locally rejected capability
stop privileged capability at trusted local terminal approval boundary
execute only automatically allowed read-only capability
explicit local yes issues and consumes one-use short-lived exact-request approval
execute approved privileged capability through bounded executor
owning paired device session submits bounded result
side_effects: complete queued request and retain bounded result

transitions.action: paired controller receives SSE result and returns validated JSON tool result to the chat loop
side_effects: append tool result to in-process conversation history

invariants: Provider output is not command authority; controller Ed25519 signing is required.
Shared bootstrap registration key cannot mint paired-device sessions.
Relay and agent both require the signed command to target the current device and agent session.
Remote request cannot self-assert local approval.
Shell and unknown capabilities deny by default.
Privileged approval is one-use exact-request bound and defaults to deny.
Provider API key is not persisted by max-chat.
failure_behavior: Fail closed before side effects on auth signature session replay policy or approval failure.
restart_behavior: Fresh agent session ID invalidates old controller sessions and stale signed commands; RemoteExecutor refreshes and re-signs a new request.
Relay in-memory state is lost on relay restart and durability is not claimed.
rollback_behavior: No automatic rollback of completed external side effects.
Revocation invalidates paired controller/device sessions for the revoked generation.
